  import sys,re
  D=sys.argv[1]
  full=open(D+"/typescript","rb").read(); start=open(D+"/ts_startup","rb").read()
  print("total bytes:",len(full)," bytes up to prompt visible:",len(start))
  for m in re.finditer(rb"\x1b\[\?(2004|1004|2026|25|1049)[hl]",full):
      ctx_before=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]",b"",full[max(0,m.start()-120):m.start()]).decode("utf8","ignore").replace("\n"," ").replace("\r"," ")[-60:]
      phase="startup" if m.start()<len(start) else "at/after /exit"
      if b"2004" in m.group(0) or b"1049" in m.group(0):
          print(f"offset {m.start():>7} [{phase}] {m.group(0)!r}  text-before: …{ctx_before!r}")
  print("2004h count:",full.count(b"\x1b[?2004h")," 2004l count:",full.count(b"\x1b[?2004l"))
  EOF
